primary.description: Original plus entity-rename/order single transformations. Entity rename and order were excluded from gradients but used in lambda selection; these contrasts are not free of development selection exposure.

secondary_compositions.description: Original plus option+rename and option+rename+order compositions. Compositions are withheld from both calibration and development, so these contrasts add validation-free composition evidence; they remain secondary to the primary held-out comparison.

optimization_time.note: Every measured paired/augmented ratio is at most 1.10.
